policy.clerk_mode: relies on the Clerk session cookie (backend-supported path); not verifiable without a live Clerk account
policy.reconnect: bounded: 3 retries, delays 500/1000/2000 ms, then LIVE STREAM DISCONNECTED + explicit reconnect

unit_tests: requires next = previous + 1 and flags gaps and duplicates
a sequence gap puts the model into a visible PRODUCT STREAM ERROR and stops consuming
retries at most MAX_RECONNECTS times, resetting derived state on every (re)connect, then reports DISCONNECTED
live events render into state; reconnect replays from 0 without double counting
replay from sequence 0 is deterministic: reset + replay rebuilds identical state (no double counting)
